title: Chapter 536
paragraphs: Chapter 536
Episode 145. Omen(5)
The counter-celestial sphere was swallowing the sky.
At the same time, the sky, the plain, the entire battlefield seemed to be about to shatter under the power of the counter-celestial, beginning to vibrate.
Broken rocks, rubble, and corpses were haphazardly lifted by that force and the empty space near the sphere distorted strangely.
Ga-aaaaaa-!
Jin screamed in agony while controlling the magic power pouring out from the mirror like crazy.
It was a range of magical power not allowed for humans. From the beginning, Jin was using several times more power than Enya had drawn.
It was a scream he didn't realize he was making, as if his entire mind was about to fly away. Rather, it was a more desperate voice closer to a shriek.
To those who heard it, it was just a horrifyingly scary sound. It felt as if some transcendent entity was proclaiming punishment and intimidating.
Everyone on the battlefield was looking at Jin's figure standing faintly in the distorted space.
'Is this... truly magic unfolded by a human?'
Both the enemy and the ally.
Even seeing it directly, they couldn't get over the shock that the subject who unfolded the counter-celestial was the 12th knight of Runcandel.
Even the vacant eyes under the hoods of the specter troops were convulsing in the light spread by the counter-celestial sphere.
Most of the battlefield does not know the existence of the mirror. However, they could see that the magic Jin was emitting was far beyond human limits.
Also, even with the help of some artifact, there was certainty that not anyone could do this.
Great magician.
No, great magic swordsman.
The counter-celestial Jin unfolded now was like a flare signaling the revival of the history of the magic sword of Runcandel.
[Infinite magic power... it's an artifact of the Colon.]
[Retreat flight, hurry to load the cannon...!]
The mass-produced ships of the red fleet began to retreat to escape the influence of the counter-celestial.
However, the invisible huge force had already grabbed the entire fleet.
Whenever they tried to break away by force, somewhere on the ship was distorted, and the protective shield was torn to pieces.
The fragments of the broken ship fell to the ground, crushing the enemy's ground troops.
Occasionally, fragments caught in the vortex fell into the allied camp, but the knights and swordsmen were all knocking them down.

Murakan and Quikantel also spread the curtains of spiritual energy and the power of time to protect their allies. If it hadn't been for them, the allies would have suffered considerable damage, but from the beginning, the counter-celestial using the mirror was a calculated move, trusting them.
Already, over 40% of the blades and chains of the Red Abyss were being absorbed into the counter-celestial.

If the wraiths of the Red Fleet had the same power as the wraiths Jin remembered, they would have blocked even the counter-celestial through the mirror. It would have been possible if there were as many as 60 superhuman magicians.
But just as a mass-produced ship couldn't compare to Kozak, the resurrected wraiths were the same. They were essentially nothing more than the dead resurrected imperfectly.
Even though they possess tremendous power, they lack the transcendence unique to true superhumans and the dignity that matches it.
[Ka-aaaa-!]
[All retreat flights impossible, abandon the ships that are already too entangled!]
The belts of red magic power being absorbed into the counter-celestial looked exactly like blood vessels.
Those blood vessels were relentlessly severed and burst, sweeping the wraiths off into the cliffs of the counterflow.

Wraiths vomiting blood were popping up everywhere. Some of them lost their minds and fell outside the broken ships, disappearing as they were swept up in the whirlpool of the counter-celestial. Not only the corpse but not a single drop of blood remained.
It would be nice to finish it before the cannon is reloaded at this rate, but except for Jin, they had no room to spare because they were protecting the allies.
The battlefield had become a hell where even ordinary people would find it hard to stand still.

Even Murakan, who was attacking the enemies by summoning a spirit spear outside the curtain protecting the allies, could not aim due to the influence of the counter-celestial. It was a situation where he couldn't help but not fully focus on the attack.
That's why Murakan was worried about Jin.
'The dimension is different from what the madman was handling, this kid...! He can't keep this much magic power in a stable state.'
It could lead to death, not just ending in a counterflow.
'I can't even check because the visibility is so bad, it's not already ruined, is it?'
In fact, for Murakan, he had to save Jin even if everyone here died. Of course, Jin wouldn't want that, but the duty as a guardian dragon was the top priority.
Moreover, if he falls into a counterflow while the counter-celestial has already progressed this far.
Not only Jin's life but everyone could be in danger.
'The infinite magical power that has already come out of the mirror doesn't stop until the formula of the magic ends. Now the kid is controlling it, but if it disappears...'
He didn't know what would happen.
Because there was no precedent.
But it's unlikely that these enormous powers released on the battlefield will disappear like a lie the moment Jin loses consciousness.

The counter-celestial, having lost control, would grow and could soon swallow even the allies. When all of that was over, there might not be a single living person left on the battlefield, let alone Jin.
When it came to that, Murakan felt as if his scales were soaring with tension and his bones were becoming brittle.
Should he approach Jin to check his condition, even if it means giving up protecting the allies for a moment?
Then the allies would die by the second. He couldn't stain the victory he had hard-won with the death of his allies.
Quikantel perceived Murakan's inner turmoil.
[Murakan, it's too late to check now. We have to focus on our work.]
He had no choice but to believe it.
As Quikantel said, if they've already crossed their limits, he himself wouldn't be able to save Jin.
Even while he was contemplating, the power of the counter-current was growing. The Red Fleet was already more than 30% destroyed, and the phantom army was completely unable to counterattack.
[Damn it! I know, I know.]
In their heyday, he wouldn't have had to worry about this.
What troubled Murakan was his own incompetence. Quikantel, as a fellow guardian dragon, knew this fact better than anyone else.
[Our contractors have always been stronger than us. Among them, Jin has always been special. So wait and see, he'll be fine as always.]
Murakan roared and expanded the barrier even further. Whenever he had the chance, he checked Jin's position, waiting for the view obscured by magic to clear.
Whether his wish was fulfilled or not, soon the magic that was blocking Jin disappeared.
[Little one!]
Murakan had been worried, but the moment Jin came into sight, he seemed to have regained his composure compared to when he was first screaming.
He was calmly controlling the magic circle of the counter-current spread all around him. Along with the magic, a familiar black energy was wrapping around him.
The power of the spirit, Solderet.
Wrapped in it, Jin looked as if he was under Solderet's protection.
And that spirit was not being directly manipulated by Jin, but originated from the counterwork engraved on the mirror, the seal of Solderet.
[That seal is a counterwork created by pouring out all his powers when Solderet had stronger powers than ever. It's not just a dense spirit, but a part of Solderet.]
Words spoken by the god of magic Clam when he saved Colon in the past.
A part of Solderet.
The infinite will left inside was guiding Jin. It was teaching him how to use this infinite magic that could potentially destroy the world, to save the world instead.
Jin felt as if he was communicating with him for the first time in a long while. He didn't hear any voices, but he felt a clearer sense of will leading him and protecting him.
'This is what it feels like to be a contractor, to have a god with me...'
The ocean of infinite magic was moving according to his will. He momentarily forgot about the horrors of war, death, and madness.
Jin was lost in ecstasy, performing magic. Along with the will of the two gods who had strived to save the world.
The magic of the counter-current that was directed at the allies was all being redirected at the enemy.
It was a result of Jin starting to perfectly control the power of the mirror.
Chaos in the allies' camp quickly subsided, and the enemies could only grit their teeth.
But their cries were blocked by the shouts of the allies and the roar of the counter-current, and were not heard anywhere.
Amazingly, not a single ally was killed by Jin's counter-current.
The Vamel Alliance and Hairan both stubbornly held on.

Although Jin had risen to the ranks of the superhuman, he was still only twenty years old. If the burden of the death of his allies was added to Jin, it seemed like he would not be able to see his face after the fight was over.
[See, I told you it would be okay. Now, regain your senses and reinforce the shield. The counter-current is waning, but your contractor doesn't seem to want to end it here.]
Magic and spirit energy.
In the midst of that, a fiery red flame was rising.
[Main cannon reloading completed!]
[Reload completed!]
At that moment, the remaining ships finished loading their main cannons.
The phantom troops hadn't noticed the flame that had begun to spread from Jin.
Therefore, they thought that if they could somehow fire, they could strike Jin.
Even if they couldn't finish him off, they were confident that they could block the damned legacy of Keydart Hall and kill at least a thousand enemies.
Seventeen cannons were opened.
It was a reloading accomplished stubbornly while retreating.
Also, the phantom troops were dressed in gray robes, though inferior to the real ones.
They were not only prepared for the main cannons but also the final chain magic.
[Let's take the enemies of Zipfel to hell with us!]
[Colon's artifact and the white stone. Everything will be laid in the glory of Zipfel...!]
The phantom troop commanders could not finish their last words.
Because they felt as if they had fallen into a pitch-black darkness all around them.
A deep darkness that made it impossible to see the person right next to them had wrapped around them unnoticed.
'Can't be!'
'This is...!'
That darkness was spirit energy. It was a deeper darkness than when Murakan dyed the sky with the curtain of spirit energy.
The final form of the annihilating heaven-burning jewel, the devil king.
The moment Jin finished his spirit chant, the cannons fired.
However, everyone on the battlefield didn't even realize the moment the red fleet's main cannons spewed fire.
Because as soon as they were fired, they were dispersed into the sun-like magic created by the annihilating heaven-burning jewel.
The legacy of Lior Zipfel.
Only with the power of Solderet could the grand magic among grand magics perfectly unfold, and it was swallowing Zipfel.
